Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official
Option legend (this build = editor):
  R  Available in editor builds, debug export templates and release export templates.
  E  Only available in editor builds.

General options:
  -h, --help                        R  Display this help message.
  --headless                        R  Enable headless mode (--display-driver headless --audio-driver Dummy).
  --, ++                            R  Separator for user-provided arguments.

Standalone tools:
  --export-release <preset> <path>   E  Export the project using the given preset and output path.
                                       The target directory must exist.
  --check-only                       E  Only parse for errors and quit (use with --script).
  --convert-3to4
    [max_file_kb] [max_line_size]     E  Converts project from Godot 3.x to Godot 4.x.
  --editor-only <path>               E  Run this operation only with --editor.
  --bare
